comments.author: @ParadoxTravel
comments.text: A 150 sqm house for $500 and $15 doctor visits, yet a sudden stroke means a 3-hour highway dash to Manila and an upfront cash deposit. Honestly, in your 70s, would you choose affordable financial freedom and human warmth here, or stay broke near a top US trauma center?

replies.author: @kevinkasp
replies.text: Neither. I’d choose to live in Bangkok near Bumrungrad Hospital which is as good or better than any major city hospital in the USA. If I lived in the Philippines and needed top level medical care I’d live near St. Luke’s hospital in Bonifacio Global City (BGC). Again another hospital that can go toe to toe against American hospitals. At both of those you can get rehab and recovery options that far exceed anything available in the USA.  At St. Luke’s they even have an entire floor with apartments for either family of patients or for patients if you need to have daily rehab and hyperbaric sessions but don’t need to be in a hospital bed. That’s way better than any recovery scenario you can have in the USA after a stroke or heart attack.
